evidence.snippet: We introduce pinn-gym, an open benchmark for material-conditioned lattice design that couples a transparent reduced-order crush-and-impact oracle with five printable polymer cards, dimensionless force-response targets and a protocol spanning curve fidelity, physical admissibility, top-k retrieval and mass regret.

claire_radar.motivation: Physics-informed machine learning is often assessed by curve error, although engineering use depends on downstream decisions: ranking candidates, avoiding infeasible designs and limiting regret.
claire_radar.name: pinn-gym
claire_radar.oneLine: An open benchmark for evaluating physics-informed surrogates in material-conditioned lattice design across prediction fidelity, physical validity, retrieval, and decision regret.
claire_radar.whyItMatters: It evaluates whether surrogate predictions support useful engineering design decisions rather than only minimizing curve error.
